acquisition method: MS data were acquired in the data-dependent mode with 3 s acquisition cycle.
cleavage agent: Crosslinked samples (red box, Fig. 3C) were reduced, alkylated and trypsin digested following standard procedures.
collision energy: The fragments were produced using CID with 35% normalized collision energy
fractionation method: Crosslinked peptides were fractionated using SCX-StageTips following the published protocol for linear peptides
fragmentation method: The fragments were produced using CID
instrument: Peptides were analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Skyline (v4.1.0.11717) for MS1-based quantification was used.
